items.headline: China holds benchmark lending rates for 17th straight month, PBOC signals shift to overnight repo rate as new policy anchor
items.why: Signals PBOC easing bias via tools rather than outright cuts - relevant to China AI-capex funding costs and yuan assets.

items.headline: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5% y/y, beating estimates and accelerating from Q2's 4.3%
items.why: Stronger China growth supports domestic AI capex (Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei) and eases hard-landing tail risk for global markets.

items.headline: OpenAI races to raise $30B at $1.4T valuation before Anthropic's IPO; says annualized revenue hit $50B post-GPT-6 Astra
items.why: Nearly doubles OpenAI's valuation in months and signals revenue scaling fast enough to justify record AI capex spend.

items.headline: Anthropic targets ~$2T valuation in IPO as early as mid-November, likely the AI trade's last major listing of 2026
items.why: A $2T print would be the largest AI IPO ever and a key read on whether public markets still want AI-lab exposure.

items.headline: Nscale in talks to sell Anthropic $45B of AI computing capacity from a new Nvidia Vera Rubin-powered West Virginia site
items.why: Another multi-billion compute commitment shows AI labs locking in capex capacity well beyond the hyperscalers.

items.headline: Taiwan to tighten AI chip and server export controls to China as part of US trade deal
items.why: Tightens the chokepoint on advanced chips reaching China, bullish for export-control enforcement plays, bearish for China AI chip access

items.headline: Nscale SEC filing discloses $103.4B in AI data-center contracts, anchored by Microsoft and Anthropic deals
items.why: Confirms scale of hyperscaler/AI-lab compute commitments to a neocloud ahead of its listing; signals capex backlog depth

items.headline: Nvidia's China data-center chip market share fell to 34% in H1 2026, shipments down 44% y/y
items.why: Quantifies how far export controls have cut Nvidia's China AI accelerator business, a read on lost TAM

items.headline: PBOC runs 700B yuan reverse repo, October net liquidity injection ~400B yuan, signaling shift to policy easing
items.why: Easing bias affects China growth/liquidity backdrop relevant to China AI and chip names

items.headline: China September new bank loans jump to 1.08 trillion yuan, beating expectations on stimulus
items.why: Signals Beijing's credit easing gaining traction, supportive of China AI capex and domestic chip/cloud demand

items.headline: BofA: weaker China Q3 economic data raises odds of additional PBOC stimulus beyond the recent mini-package
items.why: More PBOC easing would support China-exposed equities (incl. domestic AI/chip plays) and the growth outlook investors are pricing in

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announces about $2 billion of AI deals during Europe tour
items.why: Adds to Nvidia's non-US demand pipeline, countering China-share-loss concerns and broadening the AI capex cycle

items.headline: DeepSeek trains new V4 model end-to-end on Huawei's Ascend 950PR chips; Tencent, ByteDance and Alibaba order the same part
items.why: Marks a major shift of leading Chinese AI labs onto domestic silicon, accelerating China's de-risking from Nvidia and boosting Huawei's AI chip demand

items.headline: China lets provinces draw on $82B in unspent bond quotas to shore up growth
items.why: Fiscal support signal for China growth and tech/AI capex ahead of Q3 GDP release

items.headline: OpenAI ARR cut to ~$50B (Axios/CNBC) vs ~$70B scoop (Axios, Sept 29) due to differing partner-revenue accounting
items.why: Clouds growth narrative vs Anthropic; investors must discount prior $70B figure, pressuring compute-spend justification for MSFT/NVDA/ORCL
